title: Towards Detecting Cascades of Biased Medical Claims on Twitter

bias_targets.methodology: Filtering Twitter data using gender and mental health keywords, classifying the bias of the medical claims using a DistilBERT model trained on medical curriculum, and performing a network cascade analysis to measure the reach and velocity of the biased tweets compared to unbiased ones.

Included as part of the training data corpus (Bias Reduction in Curricula Content) used to train the DistilBERT Bias Classification Model, where age-biased medical curriculum excerpts were mapped to a general positive bias label.

Included as part of the training data corpus (Bias Reduction in Curricula Content) used to train the DistilBERT Bias Classification Model, where racially-biased medical curriculum excerpts were mapped to a general positive bias label.
